{{Infobox auto}}
'''Cooked pufferfish''' is a [[food]] item made by cooking a [[pufferfish]] or a [[Freshwater Puffer|freshwater puffer]]. It heals {{Value|Cooked Pufferfish|heals}} and grants [[Conduit Power]] for {{Value|Cooked Pufferfish|duration|effect=Conduit Power}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking ===
Cooking takes {{Value|Cooked Pufferfish|cook_time|station=Oven}} in an [[Oven]] and {{Value|Cooked Pufferfish|cook_time|station=Kindling}} on [[Kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_pufferfish.json}}</ref>
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Eating it gives a hidden Regeneration III for 48 ticks, which heals {{Value|Cooked Pufferfish|heals}}, and Conduit Power for {{Value|Cooked Pufferfish|duration|effect=Conduit Power|format=ticks}} ticks ({{Value|Cooked Pufferfish|duration|effect=Conduit Power|format=clock}}). Unlike raw pufferfish, it doesn't poison.
Cooked pufferfish is a cooked cod item underneath, so recipes that take [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]] also accept it.
